metadata.description: Praxis — clarity-first agent framework: opinionated taste, a visible process loop, per-project learning, cross-platform. No enforcement.

plugins.name: praxis
plugins.description: Makes the agent work out loud instead of guessing: it researches first, stops for your decision before building, and proves the result with a command you can read. Every quality gate is mutation-tested — the check is made to fail on purpose, then restored — and the evals that did NOT work are published beside the ones that did, including one that found a headline feature costing 3.65x for identical detection. Adds team memory your project commits to git (conventions, decisions, learned procedures on probation until pressure-tested), complementing the host's per-user memory rather than duplicating it. Zero dependencies, no daemon, no network calls, no database. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Copilot from one definition. Primes, never blocks.
